name: Muhammad
overview: Scripture warns believers to carefully discern prophets and their teachings, emphasizing that true prophets will bear good fruit and speak only what God commands, as seen in Deuteronomy 13:1, 18:18, and Matthew 7:16. The promise in Deuteronomy 18:18 speaks of a Prophet like Moses raised from among the brethren, while Deuteronomy 33:2 highlights the Lord’s unique revelation from Sinai and Paran. Jesus cautions believers to beware of deception (Matthew 24:4), reinforcing the need to test all prophetic claims against God's revealed Word. The record in John 1:19 illustrates the importance of seeking clear understanding about prophetic identity.
